question: What rate would someone with a 15% deposit get?
reply:
A 15% deposit means a 85% LVR, which falls in the 80.01% to 90% band.

From the page on examplelender.com.au (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time): interest rate 6.44% p.a., comparison rate 6.47% p.a. The monthly fee for this band is shown as blank in the table.

Note: this rate was current when the page was read; checking the page again would confirm it's still current.
